name: pathbridger
description: Development and Firefox release tooling for Pathbridger.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --self-hosted --no-config-discovery
scripts.package:firefox: npm run lint:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --filename pathbridger-{version}-firefox-unsigned.zip --overwrite-dest --no-config-discovery
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run lint:firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --channel unlisted --no-config-discovery
